rationale: The assistant correctly identified a blocked defrost drain as the likely cause, guided safe cleaning with a cotton bud and warm water, and added the sensible unplugging step. The fix was confirmed by the customer. Minor weaknesses: the first reply was stated with high confidence before any evidence, did not ask whether the fridge was still cold or whether the water was inside only, and the unplug advice came as a late correction. No part was recommended and none was needed. The closing advice to keep items off the back wall was reasonable and matched the case guidance.
